title: Sevilla move is a dream come true for Robbie Ure... as former Rangers youth completes remarkable rise after spells in Belgium and Sweden
description: Robbie Ure insists signing for Spanish outfit Sevilla in a sensational £7.6million deal has proved he was right to walk away from Rangers as a kid.

analysis.summary: Современная информация о séverе и аутентикте ROBOBURE URE, которая может быть важной новостью для глобальной политики.
